description: Permanently empties the Recycle Bin. Deleted files cannot be recovered.

fields.name: MinAgeDays
fields.label: Only delete items older than
fields.helpText: Items newer than this are left in the Recycle Bin. 0 = delete everything.
fields.helpDetail: Age is counted from when the item was moved to the Recycle Bin, not when the file was created. Emptying is permanent — files bypass the Recycle Bin and cannot be recovered. Use 0 to delete everything, or set 7 or 30 to keep recently deleted items for a while.
